description: This file defines a React component for a Sessions dashboard page, including server-side search, pagination, data fetching, and visualization components such as charts and a data table.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts snake_case keys to Title Case labels for display.

methods.name: buildRestrictedColumns
methods.description: Builds DataTable column definitions based on allowed fields, preserving order.

methods.name: loadAggregates
methods.description: Fetches multiple pages of session data to compute aggregates for charts by organization and type.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches session data from server with pagination, sorting, and search query.
